units: <cite ref="Yevamot 63b:13">Yeb. 63ᵇ</cite> (fr. Ben Sira) <he>אשה רעה צ׳ … מצָרַעְתּוֹ</he> a bad wife is a plague to her husband; … let him divorce her and be cured of his plague; <cite ref="Sanhedrin 100b:9">Snh. 100ᵇ</cite>.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 16:6">Lev. R. s. 16</cite>, a. fr. <he>לקה בצ׳</he> was smitten with leprosy.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 17:3">Lev. R. s. 17</cite> (ref. to <he>יסגרך</he>, <cite ref="I Samuel 17:46">I Sam. XVII, 46</cite>) <he>לשון צ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="E00699"><he>הַסְגָּרָה</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Megillah 8b:13">Meg. 8ᵇ</cite> <he>מי שצרעתו תלויה בגופו</he> he whose (seclusion on account of) leprosy depends on the condition of his body; <he>שאין צרעתו … אלא בימים</he> whose seclusion depends … on time; <he>מי שצ׳ … ברפואות</he> whose seclusion depends on his recovery; a. fr.—Pl. <he>צְרָעוֹת</he>. Sifra Thazr., Neg., Par. 3, ch. III <he>בנין אב לכל הצ׳ שיהיו וכ׳</he> (not <he>הצרעת</he>, v. R. S. to <cite ref="Mishnah Negaim 4:3">Neg. IV, 3</cite>) this verse (<cite ref="Leviticus 13:11">Lev. XIII, 11</cite>) establishes the rule for all leprosies that they must be no less than the size of a bean.
